propositions: Environment-read helper functions absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table are silently ignored by the scanner, causing their env vars to be undocumented and missing from the registry
_gate_str_pref helper in _config_resolvers.py was unregistered, causing REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE to not appear in docs/env-vars.md despite being advertised in CLI help

A parameterized-shim predicate (function whose os.environ key expression references its own parameters) can be used to detect unregistered helpers fail-closed, finding 9 instances across 557 files with only 6 registered

Registering the three unregistered helpers (_gate_str_pref, read_secret_env, _env_truthy) increases the registry from 162 to 164 documented variables, restoring completeness parity with the fail-closed os.environ accessor seam
